description: Source code for the GameView class implementing a custom Android View for a TicTacToe game, including rendering, touch handling, and game state management.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: Custom Android View for rendering and managing a TicTacToe game board.

classes.name: GameView.ICellListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to cell selection events.

classes.name: GameView.State
classes.description: Enumeration representing the state of each cell in the game (EMPTY, PLAYER1, PLAYER2, WIN, UNKNOWN).

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering of the game board, grid lines, player marks, and winning lines.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Ensures the view remains square based on the provided dimensions.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates cell size and positions when the view size changes.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles user touch input to select and toggle game cells.

methods.name: stopBlink
methods.description: Stops blinking animation on selected cell.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the game view for instance restoration.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the saved state of the game view.

methods.name: getResBitmap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap resource, with fallback for layout editor mode.
